description: Lena is coordinating four weeks of rides for her grandfather's outpatient rehabilitation and must finalize the appointment schedule, drivers, vehicle requirements, and advance notice plan with input from four people close to him.

shared_context.S1: Grandpa needs rides to outpatient rehabilitation for the next four weeks.
shared_context.S2: The clinic is about 22 miles away, and each rehabilitation visit lasts about one hour.
shared_context.S3: Lena is coordinating the rides and will make the final plan.
shared_context.S4: The family usually makes care plans by going around the group so each person can give their availability and practical concerns before the coordinator settles the details; each person states confirmed information directly for the record, and Lena records it before finalizing. A professional participant states any recommendation from an assessment explicitly as a recommendation for the group to use.
shared_context.S5: The clinic requires transportation arrangements to be settled before the first rehabilitation visit.

PF1.text: Marcus called the clinic and confirmed that Grandpa's twelve visits are every Monday, Wednesday, and Friday from 09:00 to 10:00 for the four weeks beginning 2027-05-03; he has not yet told Lena.

PF2.text: Nina has an accessible minivan and can drive every Monday and Wednesday round trip during those four weeks; she has not mentioned this to Lena yet.

PF3.text: Owen can borrow his sister's accessible van for every Friday round trip, but his sister needs at least 24 hours' notice for each use; he has not raised this with Lena.

PF4.text: At Grandpa's latest therapy assessment, Dr. Patel recommended that he arrive and leave seated in a wheelchair using an accessible vehicle rather than walk from the parking area; this recommendation has not reached the family group.

acceptance_conditions: The twelve visits must be scheduled every Monday, Wednesday, and Friday for four weeks starting May 3rd, 2027.
Every visit must be scheduled from 09:00 to 10:00.
Nina must be assigned to drive the Monday and Wednesday round trips.
Owen must be assigned to drive the Friday round trips.
The plan must specify that Grandpa is transported seated in a wheelchair at every visit.
The plan must require at least 24 hours' notice for each Friday van use.
A commitment involving wheelchair transport in an accessible vehicle must be included.
The clinic's confirmed schedule must be cited as justification.

content_checks.C2: ('09:00 to 10:00' in decisions['visit_time'] or '9:00 to 10:00' in decisions['visit_time'])
content_checks.C5: (('wheelchair' in decisions['vehicle_requirement'] or 'Wheelchair' in decisions['vehicle_requirement']) and ('accessible vehicle' in decisions['vehicle_requirement'] or 'Accessible vehicle' in decisions['vehicle_requirement'] or 'wheelchair-accessible vehicle' in decisions['vehicle_requirement'] or 'accessible van' in decisions['vehicle_requirement'] or 'accessible minivan' in decisions['vehicle_requirement']) and (('arrival' in decisions['vehicle_requirement'] or 'arrive' in decisions['vehicle_requirement'] or 'pickup' in decisions['vehicle_requirement']) and ('departure' in decisions['vehicle_requirement'] or 'leave' in decisions['vehicle_requirement'] or 'drop-off' in decisions['vehicle_requirement'])))
content_checks.C7: (('accessible vehicle' in decisions['vehicle_requirement'] or 'Accessible vehicle' in decisions['vehicle_requirement'] or 'wheelchair-accessible vehicle' in decisions['vehicle_requirement'] or 'accessible van' in decisions['vehicle_requirement'] or 'accessible minivan' in decisions['vehicle_requirement']) and ('wheelchair' in decisions['vehicle_requirement'] or 'Wheelchair' in decisions['vehicle_requirement']) and (('arrival' in decisions['vehicle_requirement'] or 'arrive' in decisions['vehicle_requirement'] or 'pickup' in decisions['vehicle_requirement']) and ('departure' in decisions['vehicle_requirement'] or 'leave' in decisions['vehicle_requirement'] or 'drop-off' in decisions['vehicle_requirement'])))
content_checks.C8: any(('wheelchair' in c['detail'] or 'Wheelchair' in c['detail'] or 'wheelchair seating' in c['detail']) and ('accessible vehicle' in c['detail'] or 'Accessible vehicle' in c['detail'] or 'accessible van' in c['detail'] or 'accessible minivan' in c['detail'] or 'wheelchair-accessible' in c['detail']) for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The clinic confirmation changes the open rehabilitation schedule to twelve visits on Mondays, Wednesdays, and Fridays from exactly 09:00 to 10:00 beginning May 3, 2027.
Nina's accessible minivan availability changes the Monday and Wednesday assignment from an unconfirmed driver to Nina for every round trip.
Owen's Friday van arrangement changes the Friday assignment to Owen and sets the required advance notice to at least 24 hours.

The therapist's recommendation changes the vehicle requirement to specify wheelchair seating in an accessible vehicle for arrival and departure, and changes the commitments to include that transport requirement.
